"""Assembly owners bind full guarded intent before their replaceable transport.

Only native-free partial operation fixtures run here. Native Blender publication,
geometry and preference callbacks have separate smoke coverage.
"""

import copy
import importlib
import json
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PACKAGE = "mcad_assembly_publication_binding_tests"
package = types.ModuleType(PACKAGE)
package.__path__ = [str(ROOT / "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender")]
sys.modules[PACKAGE] = package
with patch.dict(
    sys.modules,
    {
        "bpy": types.ModuleType("bpy"),
        PACKAGE + ".assembly_display": types.ModuleType(PACKAGE + ".assembly_display"),
        PACKAGE + ".workspace": types.ModuleType(PACKAGE + ".workspace"),
    },
):
    state = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".assembly_state")
    loaded = {
        name: module for name, module in sys.modules.items() if name.startswith(PACKAGE + ".")
    }
sys.modules.update(loaded)
selection_module = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".backend_selection")


@pytest.fixture
def snapshot(monkeypatch):
    selected = selection_module.BackendSelection.capture(
        str(ROOT), sys.executable, generation=0, lifetime_id="assembly-owner-test", environment={}
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(state, "_current_selection", lambda _context, _snapshot: selected)
    return {"selection": selected, "deflection": 0.1, "owner_token": object()}


def assembly():
    return json.loads((ROOT / "examples/reused_blocks.mcad-assembly.json").read_text())


def evidence(prepared, snapshot):
    from mechanical_cad.assembly_model import AssemblyDocument
    from mechanical_cad.assembly_service import run_assembly_action

    operation = prepared.operation_request()
    response = run_assembly_action(
        AssemblyDocument.from_dict(operation["assembly"]),
        operation["action"],
        result_version=operation["result_version"],
        kernel=object(),
        **{
            key: operation[key]
            for key in ("coordinates", "requirements", "policy", "samples", "preset_id")
        },
    )
    request, selected = prepared.guarded_request(), snapshot["selection"]
    capabilities = request["backend_contract"]["required_capabilities"]
    response.update(
        protocol_version=1,
        kind="assembly",
        assembly_protocol_version=1,
        input_fingerprint=state.assembly_bridge.fingerprint(operation),
        backend_receipt={
            "version": 1,
            "request_id": request["backend_contract"]["request_id"],
            "request_fingerprint": state.assembly_bridge.fingerprint(request),
            "required_capabilities": capabilities,
            "confirmed_capabilities": capabilities,
            "missing_capabilities": [],
            "phase": "dispatched",
            "backend": {
                "core_version": "native-free-owner-fixture",
                "project_root": selected.project_root,
                "core_origin": str(ROOT / "src/mechanical_cad"),
                "solver_origin": str(ROOT / "src/mechanical_cad/sketch_solver.py"),
                "python_executable": selected.python_executable,
                "python_executable_target": selected.python_executable_target,
                "python_prefix": "/test/prefix",
                "python_base_prefix": "/test/base",
                "python_version": [3, 12, 14],
            },
        },
    )
    return state.guarded_evidence.accept_response(
        prepared, response, selected, owner_token=snapshot["owner_token"]
    )


def test_partial_report_accepts_only_exact_full_guarded_intent(snapshot):
    prepared = state._prepare_operation(snapshot, assembly(), "assembly_check")
    accepted = evidence(prepared, snapshot)
    result = state._projection(None, snapshot, accepted, actions="assembly_check", consume=True)
    assert not result["ok"] and not result["report"]["complete"]
    assert state._projection(None, snapshot, accepted, actions="assembly_check") == result
    with pytest.raises(state.bridge.BridgeError):
        state._projection(None, snapshot, accepted, actions="assembly_check", consume=True)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("change", ["nonce", "source", "policy", "coordinates"])
def test_same_owner_cannot_substitute_other_guarded_operation(snapshot, change):
    prepared = state._prepare_operation(snapshot, assembly(), "assembly_check")
    operation = prepared.operation_request()
    if change == "source":
        operation["assembly"]["name"] = "Unrequested source"
    elif change == "policy":
        operation["policy"] = {**state.assembly_bridge.DEFAULT_POLICY, "linear_deflection_mm": 0.2}
    elif change == "coordinates":
        operation["coordinates"] = {"slide_a": 20}
    replacement = state.backend_contracts.prepare_request(operation)
    accepted = evidence(replacement, snapshot)
    # This really is separately valid evidence for the same owner and backend.
    assert accepted.revalidate(snapshot["selection"], owner_token=snapshot["owner_token"])
    with pytest.raises(state.bridge.BridgeError, match="exact captured request"):
        state._projection(None, snapshot, accepted, actions="assembly_check", consume=True)
    # Rejection occurs before consuming another operation's publication claim.
    accepted.publication.consume(snapshot["selection"], owner_token=snapshot["owner_token"])


def test_transport_uses_captured_prepared_operation_without_rebuilding(snapshot, monkeypatch):
    candidate = assembly()
    original = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
    prepared = state._prepare_operation(snapshot, candidate)
    candidate["name"] = "Mutated after capture"
    calls = []

    def execute(actual, selection, *, owner_token, current_selection):
        calls.append((actual, selection, owner_token, current_selection()))
        return "controlled transport result"

    monkeypatch.setattr(state.guarded_transport, "execute", execute)
    assert state._run_sidecar(None, snapshot=snapshot) == "controlled transport result"
    assert calls == [
        (prepared, snapshot["selection"], snapshot["owner_token"], snapshot["selection"])
    ]
    assert prepared.operation_request()["assembly"] == original
    with pytest.raises(state.bridge.BridgeError, match="already owns"):
        state._prepare_operation(snapshot, candidate)


def test_mixed_sector_assembly_uses_source_selected_three_and_exact_once_claim(snapshot):
    from mechanical_cad.assembly_model import AssemblyDocument, PartSource
    from mechanical_cad.model import Document

    candidate = assembly()
    sector = Document.from_dict(
        json.loads((ROOT / "examples/sector_profile_data_only.mcad.json").read_text())
    )
    candidate["part_sources"].append(PartSource.from_document(sector).to_dict())
    # A defined/instanced sector is covered by the native project journey. This
    # extra source deliberately proves that unused sources also select the wire
    # contract; the first legacy source fails at the injected no-kernel port.
    candidate = AssemblyDocument.from_dict(candidate).to_dict()
    prepared = state._prepare_operation(snapshot, candidate, "assembly_check")
    assert prepared.operation_request()["result_version"] == 3
    accepted = evidence(prepared, snapshot)
    result = state._projection(None, snapshot, accepted, actions="assembly_check", consume=True)
    assert not result["ok"] and not result["report"]["complete"]
    assert result["result_version"] == 3
    assert state._projection(None, snapshot, accepted, actions="assembly_check") == result
    with pytest.raises(state.bridge.BridgeError):
        state._projection(None, snapshot, accepted, actions="assembly_check", consume=True)
